description: Lower Town on Sint Eustatius is a broken line of brick and stone warehouse walls along Oranje Bay, with the cliff rising behind them. Many buildings are only foundations and partial walls. The row is not restored to a complete eighteenth-century street. Fort Oranje stays up on the cliff and is outside this frame. The sky is overcast, about 29.5°C, with wind near 20.7 km/h and cloud cover about 80%. No hotel name is shown.
